status: Resumed after parent controls; nonverdict exploration with exact LP oracles; no theorem or counterexample yet
finding: Rebuilt exact helpers (band-root eligible boxes, exact z3 dual LP: maximize the minimum normalized pairing of a nonnegative-coefficient test b at the five actual node members). On the frozen F-separation box with the worst nodes, every corner choice still admits a nonnegative test b; the worst optimum is b = 0.147s+0.040s^2+0.666s^3+0.026s^4+0.121s^5 (b0=b6=b7=0), i.e. a test divisible by s, outside the parity-member family. An exact-LP hill-climb over band endpoints, scaling K, node locations and corners for pattern (2,1,3,2,4) from 11 starts (about 2400 exact LPs) drove the dual margin down to about 1e-7 but never below zero; small margins appear only as nodes approach degenerate positions.
evidence: Kernel-only exploration; LP decisions are exact rationals but the search is not exhaustive and is not a verdict. No new file is claimed as proof.
blocker: No uniform written construction yet of a nonnegative test numerator for every pattern-(2,1,3,2,4) configuration on every eligible box.
next_action: Inspect the near-degenerate optimal configurations to identify the limiting tight structure, then attempt a written proof built from those test numerators.
